stem: Which scatterplot best represents a nonlinear relationship between the x- and y-values?

options.label: A
options.text: Scatterplot with points descending linearly from about (1,10) to (8,1)

options.label: B
options.text: Scatterplot with points ascending roughly linearly from about (1,5) to (8,9)

options.label: C
options.text: Scatterplot with points remaining about constant around y=6 from x=1 to x=8

options.label: D
options.text: Scatterplot with points showing a sharp nonlinear drop from about (1,11) to (8,1) in a curve

visual_elements: 4 scatterplots labeled A, B, C, D with x and y axes from 0 to 12; points as described in options
